title: Course: CS 47A | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Course: CS 47A | EECS at UC Berkeley CS 47A. Completion of Work in Computer Science 61A Catalog Description: Implementation of generic operations. Streams and iterators. Implementation techniques for supporting functional, object-oriented, and constraint-based programming in the Scheme programming language. Together with 9D, 47A constitutes an abbreviated, self-paced version of 61A for students who have already taken a course equivalent to 61B. Units: 1 Prerequisites: COMPSCI 61B, COMPSCI 9D, and consent of instructor. Credit Restrictions: Students will receive no credit for 47A after taking 61A.
